mentions.name: Dictatorship Simulator
mentions.description: A deckbuilder game where, instead of directly attacking your enemy, you manipulate a political simulation to do it for you. Players start out on the fringe and slowly work their way up, fighting an increasingly worried and panicky government, as well as their own.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Dictatorship Simulator. A deckbuilder where, instead of directly attacking your enemy, you manipulate a political simulation to do it for you. You start out on the fringe, and slowly work your way up, fighting an increasingly worried and panicky government - as well as your own.
